sentences.text:
This matter is taken up through Hybrid Arrangement (Virtual/Physical Mode).
2.

This is the successive journey of these Petitioners, who are apprehending their arrest in Talabania P.S Case No.155 of 2020, corresponding to G.R Case No.2747 of 2020, pending on the file of learned SDJM, Puri, running for the alleged commission of offence under section 420/294/506/34 of the IPC in filing this application under section 438, Cr.P.C., for their release on bail in the event of their arrest.

Learned counsel for the State submits that the Petitioners having been granted anticipatory bail,
when have not availed the same by not complying the condition, this second application for the same self relief is not maintainable.

5. Considering the submissions made and on going through the materials available on record including the order passed by this Court on 20.11.2020 in ABLAPL No.13853 of 2020; while being not inclined to reconsider the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail to the Petitioners, this application Raj Kumari Nayak & Others vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168683135/
1 stands disposed of with the observation that in the event, the Petitioners surrender before the Court in seissin of the aforesaid case within three (3) weeks hence and move for their release on regular bail, the same shall be considered on its own merit; further taking into account the factum of grant of bail to the co- accused, and all such developments which have taken place in the meantime in their proper perspective and disposed of early in accordance with law.
